card.title: Exam bank — every board question on recent trends

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Three questions: superconductivity definition plus two properties plus one material (2023), elementary particles with four forces strongest-to-weakest (2022), ruby-laser working with diagram plus three uses (2022). Zero resistance plus Meissner expulsion define superconductors; S-E-W-G orders the forces.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: superconductor: R = 0 below Tc + Meissner field expulsion · forces: strong > EM > weak > gravity (~10^38 span) · laser: population inversion + stimulated emission + optical cavity

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Superconductivity needs T below Tc (material-specific). Force ordering compares strengths at comparable scales. Laser action needs population inversion plus resonant cavity (meaning pump energy plus mirrors).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Mercury/lead/niobium go superconducting (name one). Baryons pack 3 quarks, mesons pair quark-antiquark. Ruby laser: chromium ions in Al2O3 rod, xenon flash pump, red 694 nm pulses — surgery, ranging, cutting uses.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2023 (2): superconductivity (zero resistance below Tc) + Meissner + one material. NEB 2022 (2): particles (quarks/leptons) + S-E-W-G order. NEB 2022 (5): ruby rod, flashlamp pump, mirrors; stimulated cascade diagram; three uses.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: force order shuffled (gravity weakest always); laser confused with ordinary light (coherence/monochromaticity missing); room-temperature superconductor claims need replication caveats.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Laser logic: pump inverts populations, passing photon stimulates twins, mirrors recycle photons through the rod — coherent avalanche. Hubble expansion: redshift proportional to distance extrapolates to a hot dense origin.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: S-E-W-G chant for forces. Superconductivity: zero-R plus Meissner plus one metal. Laser: inversion, stimulated twins, cavity — then three uses.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (2): superconductivity + properties + material. NEB 2022 (2): particles + force order. NEB 2022 (5): ruby laser + diagram + uses.
